Thought: I found the Mg potential file in /potentials/EAM/. Let me modify the LAMMPS script to use this potential file and create a simple Mg structure since the input structure file is not available.

Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/melting/brief/subtasks/magnesium_nvt_subtask_melting_trial_2/in.nvt", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Mg NVT equilibration

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Create simple Mg HCP structure
lattice hcp 3.21
region box block 0 1 0 1 0 1
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Replicate system
replicate 5 5 5

# Initialize velocity
velocity all create 300.0 12345

# Define compute for density
compute density all property/atom mass
compute sum_mass all reduce sum c_density
